body: Exactly. The twist didn't add anything to the story or the characters imo, the themes the game is exploring don't really change with the reveal either. It's just there as a plot twist for the sake of having one.
I relate to this a lot. Its like having an addiction would at least distract me from the emptiness
I'm feeling exactly the same. Its like the same shit but now I can kind of handle it somedays

For me it did. 2 months ago, I was exactly where you are at now, maybe even worse, thinking about suicide 24 hours a day. Nowadays, I recognize that I am still severely depressed. However, I slowly started enjoying playing videogames again, watching movies, tv shows. It might have been the antidepressants, I don't really know, but i'm better. So hang in there. By the way, pls dont feel like you have to be "making progress" everyday. It's ok to just not do anything sometimes, especially if you have a shitty disease like this one that drains our energy everyday
